references.title: Competitive Advantage: Creating and Sustaining Superior Performance
references.summary: The value chain: primary activities (inbound logistics, operations, outbound logistics, marketing and sales, service) and support activities (firm infrastructure, human resource management, technology development, procurement).

stance.why: Each department is tagged primary or support by Porter's activities, and the optional grouping folders take those names; product development is filed as primary for a venture whose product is its work.

references.title: APQC Process Classification Framework (PCF), cross-industry and industry-specific versions
references.summary: A hierarchical taxonomy of business processes with 13 top-level categories (from Develop Vision and Strategy to Develop and Manage Business Capabilities), published cross-industry and in industry-specific versions.

stance.why: A venture's departments are the PCF's top-level categories under short ids; the catalog maps to them and cites them rather than copying the framework's text, which carries licence terms.
